name: tuition-routine-app
description: Server-side push-notification functions for আমার টিউশন রুটিন. The app itself is a static PWA (index.html + style.css + js/*.js) with no build step — this package.json exists only so Netlify installs the two dependencies these Functions need.

scripts.test: node build.js && node --test tests/money.test.js tests/khata-tools.test.js tests/khata-plus.test.js tests/autobackup.test.js tests/radar.test.js tests/smart.test.js tests/galaxy.test.js tests/think.test.js tests/future.test.js tests/kbrain.test.js tests/ai-server.test.js tests/ai-client.test.js tests/bio.test.js tests/v75.test.js tests/v75-ui.test.js tests/ui.test.js && node --check netlify/functions/subscribe.mjs && node --check netlify/functions/unsubscribe.mjs && node --check netlify/functions/send-reminders.mjs && node --check netlify/functions/backup.mjs && node --check netlify/functions/ai.mjs
